Stream.Mode.Title: Streamer mode
Stream.Mode.Note: Hides what viewers shouldn't see: on the overlay, in the OBS windows and on the match page.
Stream.Mode.SwitchTip: Turn it on while you stream. Nothing is deleted or left unrecorded; it's only not shown.
Stream.Mode.HideNames: Opponents' names and BattleTags: the class or hero shows instead
Stream.Mode.HideRatings: The opponent's rank and Battlegrounds opponents' MMR
Stream.Mode.HideOwn: Your BattleTag on the match page and your account name in Account
Stream.Mode.Keeps: Your own rank, rating and deck stay visible.
Stream.Mode.On: Streamer mode is on: opponents' names and ratings are hidden. Click to turn it off.
Stream.Mode.Off: Streamer mode is off. Click to hide opponents' names and ratings.
Stream.Windows.Title: Windows for OBS
Stream.Windows.Note: Separate windows with overlay panels: add them to OBS as a Window Capture and place them in your scene. They show the same as the overlay and work even with the overlay off.
Stream.Window.Title: Hearthpulse — {0}
Stream.Window.DeckTip: The “Hearthpulse — Deck” window: your deck in a game, like the overlay's deck panel. Every mode but Battlegrounds.
Stream.Window.LobbyTip: The “Hearthpulse — Lobby” window: Battlegrounds players by place with health, tavern tier and last fight, like the overlay's lobby list.
Stream.Window.OddsTip: The “Hearthpulse — Combat odds” window: the odds to win, tie or lose a Battlegrounds fight. Empty between fights.
Stream.Background.ThemeTip: The current theme's background. Nothing to set up in OBS; crop the rest with Alt + drag on the source's edge.
Stream.Background.GreenTip: Pure green to key out in OBS: a Color Key filter with the Green key colour.
Stream.Background.MagentaTip: Pure magenta to key out in OBS: a Color Key filter with the Magenta key colour. Leaves the green win numbers alone.
Stream.OnTopTip: Keeps the OBS windows above other windows, the game included. OBS captures them without it too, even behind other windows.
Stream.Help.Title: Adding a window to OBS
Stream.Help.Step1: Turn a window on above; it appears on screen.
Stream.Help.Step3: In Window, pick “Hearthpulse — Deck” (or Lobby, Combat odds).
Stream.Help.Key: Key background: add a Color Key filter to the source, key colour {0}.
Stream.Help.Minimize: You can cover the window with others, but don't minimize it: OBS can't see a minimized window.
